name: Otoshigoro Gakuen
source:
The school you have just entered has a strict rule against impure sexual relationships.
Over the next 3 years, you'll get to enjoy various experiences with the heroines;
sports festivals, culture festivals, school trips, and a lot more...

Building up your stats to unlock events and ease progression.
Skills and items are important too.

20 heroines just for you!. Classmates, senpais, kohais, even teachers!
Raise their affection levels to get events with them.
You can go after multiple heroines at once, and even win over all the heroines in one playthrough!.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ351310.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
你刚入学的这所学校，严格禁止不纯洁的男女关系。
接下来的三年里，你将与女主角们共同经历各种活动。
运动会、文化祭、修学旅行，还有更多……

提升各项能力，就能解锁事件，让进展更加顺利。
技能与道具也很重要。

共有20位女主角等着你！同班同学、学姐、学妹，甚至还有老师！
提升她们的好感度，就能触发与她们相关的事件。
你可以同时追求多位女主角，甚至在一周目内赢得所有人的芳心！

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ351310.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite[/url]]
